verdict.rationale: The evidence shows machine-access primitives: service accounts, the Credential Broker for CI/CD, Connect servers and SDKs. These let a user's own pipelines and scripts fetch secrets, which makes them developer building blocks rather than automations that 1Password itself sets up and runs autonomously in the background. Nothing documents scheduled, triggered or recurring automations run by the product.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can set up automations that run autonomously in the background
